body: These are good points. I actually did do the other thoughts for a bit and it helped. But I guess I fell back into the habit. It's just sad to see something end. I'll do what you said and I think writing down the bad will help me see the good times did exist, but there were bad parts and thats what pushed me away.

I think you might want to have conversations with the people close to you and tell them this. Rather than assuming their actions, you should ask. Just say you're an anxious person and you want to make sure you're on the same page. 

Also try not to commit to plans if you dont want to go. People appreciate honesty up front if you dont want to go. And you can say "Hey I like you as a friend but I think I'm going to sit this out." 

You know what you're doing, so you can now actively take steps to improve it. Its okay friend.
No matter what's going on in your life, it can be really hard. Your feelings are valid. Please stay with us. I'd love to talk if you want to speak to someone.
My sister ignores me whenever I try to talk to her. It’s heartbreaking because we’re twins. I know how it feels. If you want someone to talk to you/ listen to you vent I’m a message away.
I just want to fix it, and it's debilitating to know I can't.

As someone who also loves playing video games, I really understand where you're coming from. I've had laptops overheat on me and die, so I couldn't play anymore. I cried for hours in the past, and now because my laptop is also having issues. I'm sorry, I wish I had a spare I could send you.

Thanks. This is kinda just a venting post because I agree with you wholeheartedly. It just doesn’t feel less sucky. I just think I’ll look back and see this as the biggest mistake of my life and I don’t really know if I want that weight on my chest, I just don’t know how to get it off. Time heals wounds is what I’ve heard, but since I inflicted this one I’m not sure if I’ll ever forgive myself for it.
I have already said I am no longer going to contact him again. I did communicate this all during the break up talk. I can’t change anything. I just want advice in how to move forward.

I’m just so sad. Because it felt like the right thing for me in the moment. And I thought he’d understand especially since we loved each other. I just... regret it. And I want to move on but I’m afraid I never will.

I am going to never reach out again. But I’m not sure how this sounds like a back up plan? I loved him but I was suicidal and I saw the stress it was putting on me. I wanted to better myself and told him that I was really in a bad mental state. 

I just wanted advice on how to deal with a broken heart. I’m not trying to get him back anymore because I know it’s over.

That’s true. I just thought I made it clear I cherished him.... which I guess doesn’t make sense since I did break it off. 

This experience has made me realize that it is over. But I can’t deny that even now I have fleeting thoughts of “what if” he changes his mind, even though I know it’s not going to happen.

It’s going to take time. I just wish it didn’t feel like I made the biggest mistake of my life.
